change: Stage server structure save header/models/edit-history prefix outside authority lock, invalidate on any concurrent history change, append live transient tail and force/atomic-publish under lock. Engine closes resources on all publication paths.

diagnostic.scope: Actual server authority, 131072 existing whole-cell edits plus one replacement cell, no dependencies/inventories/drops/clients/tick loop. Three warmups, 20 measured runs, legacy first. Exact save bytes verified outside timing. Staging includes history copy under lock; publication includes live-body validation, geometry merge, tail append, force and atomic rename. Excludes full engine validation, capture, mesh, network, rendering, memory and city/max qualification.

diagnosticCaveat: Baseline is current direct-commit fallback, including one-cell wire compression under lock, not an exact replay of the prior staged production path. Guarded history-copy time inside staging not separately measured. No other feature test/native process ran during this probe.
integration: Production server authority stages prefix outside lock; current inventory/health/drops survive reopen before ordinary close-save. Stale outside-footprint edit retains prior durable bytes and live edit. Cancellation during prefix/after staging deletes temporary files. Writer/rename errors and unexecuted resources preserve target; ordinary .tmp unaffected. Existing production TLS multiplayer rotation/late-join/restart suite passed.
diffAudit: No deleted paths against recorded review base. No diff in .github/workflows, pom.xml or AssetManager.java against base. MP3 fixtures/smokes and Hub registration tests retained.
qualification: No new format or admission caps. Full city/max fixtures, 20-run system performance, physical-GPU, shaped 32-client, peak-memory/frame/tick/traffic budgets remain unfinished. History copying and final tail+force remain guarded; busy worlds may require retries after unrelated edits. Partitioned persistence and stable rollout remain gated.
